item.title: System of a Down and Faith No More Announce First Australian and New Zealand Tour in Over a Decade
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host speaks]
Host: "Hey music fans, we've got some exciting news for you! System of a Down is finally returning to Australia and New Zealand after more than a decade. And they're not coming alone - they're bringing Faith No More as special guests!
[Sound effects: A quick clip of System of a Down's "Chop Suey!" or another popular song]
Host: "The tour kicks off in January 2027, with shows in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and Wellington. And if you're eager to get your hands on tickets, don't worry - they go on general sale on July 31st. But if you're a true fan, you can get access to pre-sales as early as July 28th.
[Sound effects: A quick clip of Faith No More's "Epic" or another popular song]
Host: "System of a Down is one of the most iconic heavy acts of their era, with a string of chart-topping albums, including Mezmerize and Hypnotize, which both debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 in 2005. And Faith No More, led by the legendary Mike Patton, has been breaking boundaries with their unique sound since the 80s.
[Sound effects: A quick clip of a crowd cheering]
Host: "So mark your calendars for January and February 2027, and get ready to rock out with System of a Down and Faith No More. It's going to be a tour you won't want to miss! Check out the tour dates and ticket information, and we'll catch you on the flip side."
[Upbeat music fades back in]
